question: Two similar polygons have a similarity ratio of \(2:3\). A side of the smaller polygon is 6 cm long. Find the length of the corresponding side of the larger polygon. (Unit: cm)
solution: The ratio of corresponding sides equals the similarity ratio: \(6/x=2/3\), so \(x=9\).
